roles.label: Affordance Perception
roles.question: What and where is interaction possible?

leaves.label: 2D Object Grounding
leaves.blurb: Affordance masks, heatmaps and part regions on RGB / RGB-D objects.

leaves.label: 2D Scene Grounding
leaves.blurb: Scene-level interactable regions from single images or egocentric views.

leaves.label: Weakly-Supervised Methods
leaves.blurb: Dense affordance learned from points, image-level labels or pseudo labels.

leaves.label: 3D Object Grounding
leaves.blurb: Affordance regions on point clouds, meshes, 3D objects and object pairs.

leaves.label: 3D Scene Grounding
leaves.blurb: Navigable, placeable and interactable regions in 3D scenes and metric maps.

leaves.label: HOI Image-based Learning
leaves.blurb: Contact regions and functional parts learned from exo/egocentric HOI images.

leaves.label: HOI Video-based Learning
leaves.blurb: Hotspots, contact and trajectories learned from human interaction videos.

leaves.label: Example-Based Transfer
leaves.blurb: Affordance transferred from few support examples, demos or reference interactions.

leaves.label: Open-Vocabulary Grounding
leaves.blurb: New affordance labels, categories and language queries via foundation models.

roles.label: Affordance Reasoning
roles.question: Which affordance matters for this task, context and agent state?

leaves.label: Explicit Relation Modeling
leaves.blurb: Affordance inferred through attributes, object relations, scene and knowledge graphs.

leaves.label: Task & Intent Understanding
leaves.blurb: Task-relevant affordance from instructions, implicit intent and LLM/MLLM priors.

leaves.label: Tool-Augmented Feasibility Reasoning
leaves.blurb: Test-time agents orchestrating tools, memory and feasibility checks over affordances.

roles.label: Affordance-Guided Action
roles.question: How does affordance become executable behavior?

leaves.label: Primitive-based Execution
leaves.blurb: Contact points and actionability turned into grasps, primitives and trajectories.

leaves.label: Correspondence & Memory-based Action
leaves.blurb: Affordance memory, retrieval and correspondence transferred into executable actions.

leaves.label: Affordance-Guided Planning
leaves.blurb: Affordance as spatial goal, constraint or cost inside planners and optimizers.

leaves.label: Affordance as Explicit Input
leaves.blurb: Masks, points, contacts and plans conditioning policies, VLAs and diffusion policies.

leaves.label: Affordance as Implicit Representation
leaves.blurb: Affordance as latent feature, auxiliary prediction or intermediate representation.

leaves.label: Affordance as Optimization Signal
leaves.blurb: Affordance constraining candidates, shaping rewards or specifying exploration goals.
